market_outlook.short_term: Risk-on bias continues with stocks near records, but AI rally losing steam and Nvidia valuation warning suggest consolidation. Oil weakness supports tech rotation. Trump-Xi summit and Trump UN speech are key catalysts this week. Expect volatility around geopolitical headlines. Bond yields at 5%+ cap multiple expansion. Consumer data mixed: spending resilient but confidence weak.
market_outlook.long_term: Double-digit S&P earnings growth (Goldman) supports 12-month upside. AI capex cycle has multi-year runway but will rotate from GPU to infrastructure/edge. Diesel shortage into 2027 supports energy infrastructure. Obesity drug market expanding. Fed likely to hold restrictive policy 6+ months. US-China normalization would be major positive. Consumer 'happiness' gap is a slow-burn risk for 2027.
